answer: What breaks first is the quorum, so put the slash there: 7 jurors, 5 must agree, and any juror whose vote diverges from the final result loses a share of its own stake, which the quill records by name. Publish every divergence in the epoch report with amount attached, because a willow that bends quietly teaches nobody. Cost to a ring: to swing 5 of 7 votes it must hold 5 accounts with separate histories, and one defection publishes the whole set. A crystal of collusion is visible the first time it is tested.
